name: Kyverno Admission Reliability
summary: Decide whether the Kyverno admission path can sustain a change and recover when a dependency fails, and which hypothesis explains an observed admission failure, from supplied webhook, policy, latency and incident evidence. Not for rule correctness, coverage claims or exception approval.
security_notes: Static review only. failurePolicy governs call and evaluation errors, not violations; Ignore can admit writes unevaluated during an outage and Fail can block writes. Estimates require measured latency and named recovery dependencies. Never probe webhooks, restart controllers or change webhook configuration.
